title: Audio Response
description: Speaking prompt: the learner records an audio response, transcribed and graded by AI and/or a human rater.
x-when-to-use: When the speaking prompt asks the learner to record an audio response (e.g. IELTS Speaking Part 1/2/3).
x-when-not-to-use: Use SHORT_ANSWER for typed text. Use a non-speaking type entirely if the prompt is not a speaking task.

payload.promptMd: Describe a memorable journey you have taken. You should say where you went, how you travelled, and explain why it was memorable.

acceptedTranscriptions: Last summer I travelled by train through the Scottish Highlands with two friends.
correctAnswer.modelTranscription: Last summer I travelled by train through the Scottish Highlands with two friends. We spent three days hiking near Glencoe and the views from the ridge were unforgettable.

maxDurationSec.description: Maximum recording length, in seconds (1 second to 10 minutes).
x-common-mistakes: Setting >120 without good reason makes transcripts noisy
Setting <30 blocks anything but Part 1 short answers

promptAudioUrl.description: Optional audio prompt the learner hears before recording.

acceptedTranscriptions.description: Whitelisted reference transcriptions the learner response is matched against.

modelTranscription.description: Optional canonical model transcription used as a reference answer.

scoring.description: Who scores the response: AI, human, or both.

rubric.description: Optional rubric used by AI or human raters.
